summary: To test a collection, clone it into a path ending in ansible_collections/<namespace>/<name>, clone its collection dependencies into the same collection root, then cd into the collection directory.
questions: Where do I have to clone a collection so ansible-test can find it?
Why does ansible-test not find the collections my collection depends on?
How do I set up community.windows for local testing?
Does ansible-test use my configured collections paths?

answer_card.title: Set up a collection for ansible-test
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Clone the collection so its path ends in `ansible_collections/<namespace>/<name>`:
   ```shell
   git clone https://github.com/ansible-collections/community.windows ~/dev/ansible_collections/community/windows
   ```
2. Clone every collection it depends on (see its `galaxy.yml`) into the **same** collection root, for example `~/dev/ansible_collections/ansible/windows`. `ansible-test` ignores your configured collection paths and other Ansible config.
3. `cd ~/dev/ansible_collections/community/windows` and run tests from there.
